title: Creepy-but-true fact over one slow shot
summary: One slow, moody shot with no cuts, and one unsettling true fact typed on screen. Use AI to find the fact and build the shot.
why: Two TikTok trend reports from mid-October 2026 (October 15 and October 18) list "creepy fact storytime" as rising: an unsettling fact over a slow shot with no cuts, set to a quiet eerie sound. Halloween is October 31.
steps: Ask a text AI for a few creepy-but-true facts on a topic you like, then check the one you pick on a trusted site.
Film one slow shot yourself (a dark hallway, a foggy field, the bottom of a lake), or make one with an AI video tool using the shot prompt.
Add the fact as on-screen text in two or three short lines. Keep the shot going with no cuts.
Add a quiet, eerie sound from the app's library and post it before Halloween.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the fact
prompts.text: Give me 5 creepy but true facts about [topic, for example: the deep ocean, the human body, old houses, or Canadian winters]. Each one must be well known and easy to check, with no gore. Write each as two short lines that work as on-screen text: line 1 sets it up, line 2 is the chilling part. After each fact, name the kind of source I could check it with, like an encyclopedia or a science museum website. Don't include anything you are unsure of.

prompts.label: Shot prompt: AI video
prompts.text: A single slow, steady camera push forward down [scene, for example: an empty wooden hallway lit only by a window at the far end]. Late evening, cool blue light, light dust in the air. Nothing jumps out and nothing moves except the camera. Vertical 9:16, about 8 seconds, no cuts, no people, no text.

prompts.label: Variation: cosy, not scary
prompts.text: Give me 5 strange but true facts about [topic, for example: owls, the moon, or autumn leaves] that feel a little eerie but are fine for kids. Write each as two short on-screen lines. Name the kind of source I could check it with. Nothing gory or frightening for young children.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run a [type of business, for example: an old bookshop in a heritage building]. Give me 3 eerie but true facts about [something real tied to my business, for example: the history of paper, or old buildings like mine], written as two short on-screen lines each. End with a soft caption that invites people in for Halloween week. No made-up history, no ghost claims about my building, no prices.

tips: Check every fact before you post. AI can sound sure and still be wrong.
Slow is the point. A steady push or a still shot works better than fast edits.
Keep the text on screen long enough to read twice.
Leave a pause before the chilling line so it lands.
